string.text: Show or hide the HUD minimap with a keybind. Toggle flips it; Hold shows it only while the key is down. While on, it keeps re-forcing the map (and HUD indicators) so other UIs that hide it cannot stick. No key bound by default. To keep the full HUD up behind the item wheel without forcing, turn off Quick Action Wheel -> Controls -> Hide HUD.
Toggle flips the minimap; Hold shows it while held. Optional modifier below can reduce conflicts.
Toggle: flip on press. Hold: show only while the key is held (starts hidden in Hold).
Wait this long after press/hold before showing. Hide is immediate. Use 0 unless you share the key with the item wheel - a non-zero delay needs a real hold past that time.
